name: app-white-cards-with-huge-percentages-and-blue-progress-bars
title: Huge Percentages with Blue Progress Bars
whatItIs: A pale slide with a numbered User Interview & Insight pill and three staggered white cards, each with a topic, a very large percentage, a label, a blue progress bar and a sentence, and a closing statement bottom right.
whatItMeans: Enormous numerals and simple bars make research findings instantly readable.
techniques: Giant bold percentages as the hero
Small descriptive sentence at the card base

vocabulary.definition: A very large number that is the focal point of a card.
A bar showing a proportion filled.
Cards offset vertically to avoid a rigid grid.
